samples.summary: New user-facing feature + new persisted-preference module lands with no design doc added or updated
samples.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 requires "Feature / non-trivial change → write or update a design doc under docs/design/ ... a PR that includes the design doc and the code". This PR adds a new Settings preference and a new frontend preference-store module (`packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts`) plus new formatting behavior for the documents list, but touches no file under docs/design/. The natural homes exist and were not updated: `docs/design/frontend.md` already documents the Settings route (line 50) and the ThemeProvider's localStorage-persisted preference (line 539), and `docs/design/documents-last-modified.md` is the canonical doc for the list's Modified column. Only a task plan (docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md) exists, which is the execution plan, not the design doc.

samples.summary: localStorage access is unguarded, diverging from the established repo pattern for browser-persisted preferences
samples.evidence: Every other localStorage-backed preference in this package wraps access in try/catch precisely because storage can throw in private mode / with storage blocked: board-grid.ts:220-236 ("Storage can throw outright in private mode / with cookies blocked"), notes-settings.ts:12-28, api/analytics.ts:47-53, font-recents.ts:23-26. `getDateFormat`/`setDateFormat` read and write directly, and `getDateFormat` is the `useSyncExternalStore` snapshot for every documents-list render.

samples.summary: Storage key naming does not follow either existing convention in the repo
samples.evidence: Existing keys are namespaced with `:` or `.` segments — `wafflebase:notes:viewMode` / `wafflebase:notes:keymap` (notes-settings.ts:9-10), `wafflebase.board.grid` / `wafflebase.board.grid-snap` (board-grid.ts). The new key is `wafflebase-date-format`, a third style, making future prefix-based cleanup/migration harder.

samples.summary: Generic, non-documents date formatters live in a documents-feature util, forcing the Settings page to import from `@/app/documents/*`
samples.evidence: `formatExactDate` / `formatFullDateTime` are locale date formatters with no documents-list specificity, yet they are added to `app/documents/document-list-utils.ts`; `app/settings/page.tsx` now imports them across feature trees, while the sibling preference store was placed in `@/lib`. `@/lib/utils.ts:16` already hosts a (differently-shaped) `formatRelativeTime`, so date formatting is now spread across three locations. Placing the new formatters in `@/lib` would keep Settings independent of the documents feature.

samples.summary: Tooltip uses the native `title` attribute while the file already imports the design-system Tooltip components
samples.evidence: document-list.tsx imports `Tooltip`/`TooltipTrigger` (diff context around line 93) but `DateCell` uses `title={formatFullDateTime(value)}`. The task plan explicitly asked for `title=`, and other cells in the file use `title=` too, so this is consistency taste only — but styled tooltips are the repo's richer option.

samples.summary: The setting is labelled globally ("Dates") but only affects the documents list columns
samples.evidence: Other date renderings keep relative-only formatting: notification-item.tsx:47, files/generic-file-view.tsx:41, comments components via @/lib/utils, datasource-list.tsx:160. The helper text does scope it to "document lists", and the task plan lists these as out of scope, so this is only a UX-consistency note / possible follow-up.

finding.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 requires "Feature / non-trivial change → write or update a design doc under docs/design/ ... a PR that includes the design doc and the code". This PR adds a new Settings preference and a new frontend preference-store module (`packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts`) plus new formatting behavior for the documents list, but touches no file under docs/design/. The natural homes exist and were not updated: `docs/design/frontend.md` already documents the Settings route (line 50) and the ThemeProvider's localStorage-persisted preference (line 539), and `docs/design/documents-last-modified.md` is the canonical doc for the list's Modified column. verdict.reason: Verified independently. The change adds a real user-facing feature plus a new persisted-preference module (packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts:13-59: DateDisplayFormat, localStorage key "wafflebase-date-format", custom same-tab change event, useDateFormat via useSyncExternalStore), consumed by settings/page.tsx, documents/document-list.tsx and document-list-utils.ts. No design doc documents it: repo-wide greps for date-format-preference|useDateFormat|formatExactDate|formatFullDateTime|formatListDate|wafflebase-date-format return zero hits under docs/design/ (only docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md); a case-insensitive search for "date format|Date Display|date-display" across all of docs/ hits only unrelated Sheets number-format docs; globs docs/design/**/*settings* and docs/design/**/*preference* find no files, so there is no alternate home doc. The two natural homes are demonstrably untouched: docs/design/documents-last-modified.md is entirely about updatedAt ingestion/ordering (read in full, lines 1-107, no display-format or tooltip content), and docs/design/frontend.md has no tooltip/date-format text while it does document the Settings route (line 50) and the ThemeProvider localStorage preference (line 539). CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 requires a feature/non-trivial change to ship the design doc with the code, and CONTRIBUTING.md:55-63 explicitly separates a task execution plan from the design doc. Repo precedent shows localStorage-backed UI preferences are recorded in design docs (frontend.md:539, homepage.md:233, board/board.md:194, slides/slides-fonts.md:209), so this is the project norm rather than reviewer taste. Under this lens's design-doc-discipline rubric a missing required design doc is major; I found no counterexample.
